title: Wiemer footer
description: A calm pale grey footer: a plain wordmark on the left and a two-line promise on the right, three narrow link columns with pale grey labels beside a teaser card, and a last line with the copyright and the company behind the brand. Links grow an underline from the left on hover. On phones everything stacks.
notes: the card is a wiemer-teaser-card; leave it out with card={undefined}
